extension.description: Reviews procedural-memory CLI commands that write the skill store: deleting a learned skill, and importing legacy skills, which replaces any stored skill with the same intent. Reads such as list and show stay unreviewed.
extension.name: procedural-memory command protection

permissions.description: Identifies `procedural-memory delete <intent>` and its `python -m procedural_memory` forms, which permanently remove a learned skill and its usage stats from the skill store. The agent then has to rediscover the procedure on the next matching request.
permissions.label: procedural-memory skill delete
safer_guidance: Run procedural-memory show <intent> first and keep a copy of the skill JSON.
Run procedural-memory list to confirm the intent name and the --root directory.

permissions.description: Identifies `procedural-memory import-legacy <dir>` and its `python -m procedural_memory` forms, which write skills into the store and replace any stored skill with the same intent, so a working procedure can be overwritten by an imported one.
permissions.label: procedural-memory legacy skill import
safer_guidance: Import into an empty --root directory first and review the result with procedural-memory list.
Back up the target skills directory before importing into it.

rules.description: Identifies `procedural-memory delete <intent>` and its `python -m procedural_memory` forms, which permanently remove a learned skill and its usage stats from the skill store. The agent then has to rediscover the procedure on the next matching request.
safer_alternatives: Run procedural-memory show <intent> first and keep a copy of the skill JSON.
Run procedural-memory list to confirm the intent name and the --root directory.
rules.title: procedural-memory skill delete

rules.description: Identifies `procedural-memory import-legacy <dir>` and its `python -m procedural_memory` forms, which write skills into the store and replace any stored skill with the same intent, so a working procedure can be overwritten by an imported one.
safer_alternatives: Import into an empty --root directory first and review the result with procedural-memory list.
Back up the target skills directory before importing into it.
rules.title: procedural-memory legacy skill import

safer_alternatives: Inspect the store with procedural-memory list and procedural-memory show <intent> before changing it.
Point --root at a scratch directory when trying an import.

cases.command: pipx run --spec scriptflow-procedural-memory procedural-memory delete create_note_for_record
uv tool run --from scriptflow-procedural-memory procedural-memory delete create_note_for_record
uv run python -m procedural_memory delete create_note_for_record
uv run --with rich python3.12 -m procedural_memory.__main__ --root ./skills delete create_note_for_record
uv run python -W ignore -m procedural_memory delete create_note_for_record
uv run python -m other_tool delete create_note_for_record
